notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
v1.6 Release Notes:

Player Swap
- Overhauled system to resolve some annoying rotational issues that would sometimes come up
- Added 0.5 second delay before taking over an AI character to allow the player a chance to adjust position

Other Changes \ Fixes
- Adjusted the audio falloff range to a larger distance so those long shots from corner to corner are not as quiet
- Resolved an issue where the player would fall thru the map after finishing a match.  It was really difficult to recreate often but I was able to reproduce it once and made an adjustment to prevent that.

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Patch 1.5 Release Notes:

General improvement to AI shooting, the AI will seek to shoot a bit more often to catch the player peeking instead of being biased toward vision of the player.
